defmodule Corpus do
  @moduledoc "not mutated: 1 + 2"
  @type t :: 1 | 2
  @compile {:inline, plain: 1}

  use Foo, flag: true
  import Bar, only: [a: 1]
  alias Baz.Qux, as: Q
  require Logger

  defstruct count: 0, tags: [:a, :b]

  defmacro twice(x), do: quote(do: unquote(x) + unquote(x))
  defguard small(x) when x < 10
  defmacrop hidden(x), do: x
  defguardp tiny(x) when x < 3
  defdelegate other(x), to: Elsewhere

  def plain(x) when x > 0 and x < 10 do
    y = x + 1
    IO.puts(y)
    z = y * 2 - 1
    send(self(), z)
    y / 2
  end

  def plain(_), do: nil

  def flags(a, b) do
    if a && b, do: true, else: false
    unless a || b, do: 1, else: 2
    a == b or a != b
    a === b and a !== b
    a <= b
    a >= b
    a > b
    a < b
    not a
  end

  def clauses(x) do
    case x do
      1 -> :one
      2 -> :two
      _ -> :many
    end

    cond do
      x > 1 -> :big
      true -> :small
    end

    with {:ok, v} <- x, do: v
    for i <- [1, 2, 3], do: i * 2
    receive do
      :ping -> :pong
    after
      10 -> :timeout
    end

    try do
      x
    rescue
      _ -> 0
    end

    f = fn
      1 -> :a
      _ -> :b
    end

    g = fn y -> y end
    f.(g.(x))
  end

  def collections(m) do
    list = [1, 2, 3]
    [head | tail] = list
    map = %{"b" => 2, a: 1}
    updated = %{map | a: 3}
    struct = %Corpus{count: 1}
    tuple = {1, 2}
    bin = <<1, 2>>
    mixed = <<"a", 1>>
    cap = &(&1 + 1)
    pin = ^m
    {head, tail, updated, struct, tuple, bin, cap, pin}
  end

  def strings(name) do
    "plain"
    "hello #{name}"
    ""
    'charlist'
    ~s(sigil #{name} #{1 + 2})
    String.upcase(name)
  end

  def query(q) do
    q |> where(x == 1) |> or_where(y == 2)
    from(p in Post, where: p.id == 1, or_where: p.id == 2, select: p)
    from(p in Post, select: p)
  end

  def extras(m, from) do
    a
    Foo.Bar
    fn x -> x end
    quote do: 1
    %{k: 1}
    %Corpus{}
    {1, 2, 3}
    &(&1)
    ^m
    a | b
    a when b
    1.5
    q |> where
    q |> limit(1)
    from(Post)
    from
    m
  end

  def two do
    IO.puts("a")
    :b
  end

  def multi do
    fn
      1, 2 -> :x
      _, _ -> :y
    end
  end

  defp private(x), do: x

  defp guarded(x) when is_integer(x), do: x
  def unnamed, do: 5
  def nilled, do: nil
  def block_nil do
    IO.puts("x")
    nil
  end

  def unquoted(name) do
    def unquote(name)(x), do: x
  end

  defmodule Inner do
    def deep(x), do: x - 1
    defmodule Deeper, do: def(go, do: 0)
  end

  defmodule __MODULE__.Child do
    def child, do: 1
  end

  defmodule unquote(:dynamic) do
    def dyn, do: 1
  end

  defimpl String.Chars, for: Corpus do
    def to_string(c), do: "corpus #{c.count}"
  end

  defprotocol Sizer do
    def size(x)
  end

  defoverridable plain: 1
  defexception message: "boom"
  def last_call, do: IO.puts("last")
end

defmodule :erlang_style do
  def f, do: 1
end
